office_does: A State Senator writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital and transportation budgets for a four-year term, and the Senate confirms gubernatorial appointments.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Rep. Alex Ybarra (Prefers Republican Party), who holds the district's House Position 2 seat, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: 13th District State Representative (appointed, then elected in 2019), former Quincy School Board president and Grant County PUD analyst; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Appointed and then elected in 2019 as 13th District State Representative; ranking member on Postsecondary Education and Workforce [S1][S2]
Voted against ESSB 6346 and called it an unconstitutional income tax [S3][S4]
Voted against ESHB 1296, the 2025 changes to the I-2081 parental-rights law [S5]
